svg.title: Network Security Scanner - scanner with real firewall enforcement
svg.desc: Flask and Nmap scanner. Rules run real iptables or netsh commands, ports that opened since the last scan raise Wazuh alerts, and the Wazuh rules are tested on Wazuh 4.14.9.

g.text: Flask and Nmap. Rules run real iptables or netsh commands, and new open ports
